scope: Proposition 3.2 (Saturation) of the manuscript “Rokhlin's multiple-mixing problem for one transformation” (preprints/Rokhlins-multiple-mixing-problem-for-one-transformation-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 145 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 45000cec6bcec95d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every array object has an extension with the following property. For every n ≥ 1, every F ∈ L2(mn), and each D ∈ {Pn} ∪ {Gn,j, On,j : j ∈ I}, no extension increases the norm of E[F | D] after pullback. More precisely, if θn is the coordinatewise factor map from any extension and D′ is the corresponding data in that extension, then E[F ◦ θn | D′ ] = E[F | D] ◦ θn. (4)
